question: Which deities become manifest in the earth era and in the nectar part, beloved?
premises: Mādhava becomes manifest in the earth era.
Virajā becomes manifest in the nectar part.
inference: Mādhava manifests in the earth era and Virajā manifests in the nectar part.
uncertainties: The terms bhū-śāka and sudhā-aṃśa are era-specific.
plain_english: In the earth era Mādhava is manifest, and in the nectar part Virajā, O beloved.
